4768.title: Runtime installer requires registry URL metadata
4768.rootCauseOneLine: The npm install inherits a setting that omits resolved URLs, but the runtime lockfile validator requires them for pinned-registry verification.
4768.proposedFix: Require registry URL metadata for this isolated npm install while retaining all registry, signature, provenance, checksum, and executable checks.
4768.caveats: Reproduced on Linux with npm 10.9.3; the reported macOS/npm environment and browser-session UI were not exercised. Both clean reproductions were performed by the same agent.
